neighbours.label: the token while/While/whilst, strongest as a conjunction opening a clause, weaker for the noun 'a while'
fire: The power went out. While we waited, we played cards by candlelight.
Costs went up again. Whilst sales held steady, profits shrank.
He listened to the radio while he fixed the bicycle.
The market is busy. While some stalls sell fruit, others sell spices.
Please do not talk while the film is playing.
The children slept while their parents packed the car.
She studied French whilst living in Lyon.
Our flight was delayed. While it was annoying, the airline gave us vouchers.
quiet: The power went out. As we waited, we played cards by candlelight.
Costs went up again. Although sales held steady, profits shrank.
He listened to the radio as he fixed the bicycle.
The market is busy. Some stalls sell fruit, and others sell spices.
Please do not talk during the film.
The children slept as their parents packed the car.
She studied French when living in Lyon.
Our flight was delayed. Though it was annoying, the airline gave us vouchers.
